sources.title: ControlNet: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview ControlNet is a neural network architecture that adds spatial control to Stable Diffusion 1.5 image generation by conditioning the diffusion process on auxiliary control inputs like edge maps, depth estimates, pose skeletons, semantic segmentation, and hand-drawn scribbles. sources.title: lllyasviel/ControlNet | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: What is ControlNet? ControlNet is a neural network structure introduced in the paper "Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models." It extends Stable Diffusion models by enabling them to accept additional conditional inputs beyond text prompts. This allows for precise control over the generated images while preserving the original model's capabilities.
